title: InstantID SDXL character references
description: Experimental local image workflow for producing candidate character references from one face image with InstantID and SDXL. Identity consistency and output quality have not been evaluated.

requirements.name: CheckpointLoaderSimple
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing CheckpointLoaderSimple.

requirements.name: LoadImage
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing LoadImage.

requirements.name: CLIPTextEncode
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing CLIPTextEncode.

requirements.name: EmptyLatentImage
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing EmptyLatentImage.

requirements.name: KSampler
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing KSampler.

requirements.name: VAEDecode
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing VAEDecode.

requirements.name: SaveImage
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing SaveImage.

requirements.name: ControlNetLoader
requirements.instructions: Install a current ComfyUI version providing ControlNetLoader.

requirements.name: InstantIDFaceAnalysis
requirements.instructions: Install cubiq/ComfyUI_InstantID with its declared insightface, onnxruntime, and onnxruntime-gpu dependencies.

requirements.name: ApplyInstantID
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed cubiq InstantID custom node; it is in maintenance-only mode upstream.

requirements.name: ip-adapter.bin
requirements.instructions: Download ip-adapter.bin into ComfyUI/models/instantid. No checksum is asserted by this bundle.

requirements.name: instantid/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Download diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors into ComfyUI/models/controlnet/instantid. No checksum is asserted by this bundle.

requirements.name: models/antelopev2
requirements.instructions: Install the complete antelopev2 InsightFace model pack under ComfyUI/models/insightface/models/antelopev2; buffalo_l is not supported by this workflow.

requirements.name: sdxl/AlbedoBaseXL.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the SDXL checkpoint named by cubiq's reviewed basic example at ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/sdxl/AlbedoBaseXL.safetensors, or revise and re-review the workflow bundle before selecting another checkpoint.

evidence: The manifest and API-format graph are mapped from cubiq's official README and basic example at commit 72495e806bc2ab9c41581e15ccaa1bcf83c477e8. No local generation, identity evaluation, output-quality evaluation, recovery, cancellation, offline behavior, or hardware use has been qualified.
No hosted adapter or provider has been selected, implemented, or qualified.
